name: algerian-commerce/core
description: Headless commerce application layer for WordPress/WooCommerce.

autoload-dev._comment_exclude_from_classmap: tests/Api holds scripts, not classes: they run through wp eval-file against a booted WordPress, so their helpers are deliberately global and unnamespaced. Composer scans the whole PSR-4 root and warns about them. Excluding the directory states that, rather than renaming a class to satisfy a rule that does not apply to a script.
